Table 4 transfer matrix and disjoint held-out protocol verified. Evaluation tasks are selected from the seed-0 intersection of failures of both recipients; gains therefore support the frozen bundle+task-conditioned-adapter protocol on this hard selected set, not full-distribution effect sizes or component isolation. GPT donor is stronger or tied, not strictly higher in every cell.
Selective beats full-bank, but selective vs always-inject is aggregation-dependent: macro favors selective 64.3 vs 63.5, micro favors always-inject 61.5 vs 61.2.
Table 2/3 numbers verified; w/o-Subgoal removes subgoal decomposition and context folding together, so folding is not causally isolated.
Inherited drift, 16/32-step recovery pattern, goal-recognition/action gap, and environment dependence verified; mitigation proposals remain extrapolated.

206-VLM/31-benchmark setup, Pocock sequential method, 15/30/50% CI targets, >2pp >=60% savings, 55% vs 76% pair resolution and 63% deployment case verified. ±3/±2/±1.5 values are 95% CI half-width targets; many-model multiple-hypothesis correction is explicitly simplified.

AgentSuite Filtering explicitly re-scores the same Original trajectories with no reruns. tau-bench, CFBench, ACEBench and overall rank reversals are verified from committed CSVs. Filtering drops FIX/TODO as well as REMOVE, so the evidence is audit-flagged task-composition sensitivity, not proof every dropped task is invalid; Fixed behavior is separate and not live on the current leaderboard.

9 judges on 1,000 MNLI items give Kish n_eff=2.18 [2.07,2.31], mean phi=.391, panel 72.0% vs best single 71.8%; RewardBench n_eff=1.99 [1.83,2.20], panel 92.7% vs best single 95.5%. CoT increases correlation in this tested setup and one-per-family n_eff is 1.93. Do not treat n_eff≈2 as universal or directly transfer classification/preference results to open-ended O evaluation without measurement.
